title: LightGBM: A Highly Efficient Gradient Boosting Decision Tree
summary: Guolin Ke, Qi Meng, Thomas Finley, Taifeng Wang, Wei Chen, Weidong Ma, Qiwei Ye, and Tie-Yan Liu published "LightGBM: A Highly Efficient Gradient Boosting Decision Tree" in December 2017. The paper describes LightGBM as a gradient-boosting decision-tree implementation using Gradient-based One-Side Sampling (GOSS) and Exclusive Feature Bundling (EFB) to improve training efficiency and scalability.
significance: A documented machine-learning systems milestone for efficient gradient-boosted decision trees, recorded from the official NeurIPS proceedings and Microsoft Research publication record.

verification.note: The official NeurIPS 2017 proceedings identify the authors and describe LightGBM as a GBDT implementation using GOSS and EFB. Microsoft Research independently lists the publication in December 2017. LINEAiGE records only the December 2017 publication milestone at month precision and does not infer a universal software-birth date, release day, geography, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationships.
